s.p.learn.def_txt: 8 mafunso pa mawu kuchokera ku level yanu. Ready?
s.p.learn.ai_p1: M'tsogolomu: mudzatha kucheza ndi AI yogwirizana, m'zinenero zosiyanasiyana komanso pa level yomwe mumasankha, pa nkhani iliyonse (kuyenda, ntchito, moyo wa tsiku ndi tsiku).
s.p.learn.ai_p2: N’chifukwa chiyani sichoncho? Chilankhulo AI amafuna ntchito yakunja. Key yake ayenera kukhala chitetezo pa seva, nthawi zonse mu webusaitiyi. Cholakwika ndi kusinthidwa ndi palibe mtengo umachitika popanda chilolezo chanu.
s.p.learn.cult_p1: M'tsogolomu: mayiko ndi zigawo, miyambo, nkhani, malemba ndi mavidiyo, kuphunzira zinenero.
s.p.learn.cult_p2: Zolemba zimakonzedwa monga maphunziro: fayilo imodzi pa nkhani, yowonjezera popanda kusintha pulogalamuyo.
s.p.learn.no_voice: Chilankhulo sichipezeka pa chipangizo ichi. Malemba omwe amati:
s.p.profil.title: Profile ya Chilankhulo
s.p.profil.sum_empty: Tiuzeni zinenero zanu: Face to face ndi Kuphunzira kusintha kwa iwo.
s.p.profil.sum_create: Pangani ma profile anga a zinenero
s.p.profil.priv_synced: 🔒 M'nyumba: pa chipangizochi ndi muakaunti yanga
s.p.profil.priv_contacts: 👥 Zilankhulo zomwe zimawonekera kwa anthu anga olumikizana nawo
s.p.profil.pseudo_note: dzina lanu logwiritsa ntchito pagulu ndi dzina lanu la ku Messaging (lokonzedwa mu Messaging). dzina lowonetseratu silifunika.
s.p.profil.name: Imelo (yosafunikira)
s.p.profil.level_hint: Mlingo wovomerezeka, m'madera a Europe (A1 woyamba → C2 mastery).
s.p.profil.levels: A1 · Woyamba (mawu, mawu osavuta)|A2 · Elementary (mafunso a tsiku ndi tsiku)|B1 · Woyamba (kuyenda, kulankhulana kosavuta)|B2 · Upper intermediate (kulankhula bwino)|C1 · Advanced (kapena zonse)|C2 · Kumvetsetsa (monga munthu wochokera kudziko lina)
s.p.profil.ui_note: Masambawa ali m'zinenero 11; Messages amapezeka m'zinenero 31 (zosankha zofanana).
s.p.profil.fav_note: Amaperekedwa koyamba m'maso motsutsana ndi maso ndi kuyenda (6 panthawi).
s.p.profil.reading_note: Mofulumira: mawu ochepa pazenera m'mafunso ozungulira, ndi malo ambiri. Mofulumira: mawu ambiri.
s.p.profil.hands: Hands-free (mikrofoni amapita kwa munthu wina ndi yekha)
s.p.profil.sync_note: Osagwira ntchito: profil yanu imakhala pa chipangizo ichi. Ikugwira ntchito: imasungidwa muakaunti yanu kuti muthe kuyipeza pazinthu zina zanu. Palibe wina amene angaiwerenge.
s.p.profil.sync_need: Mufunika 24/24 ONE WORLD akaunti (a dzina logwiritsa ntchito) kuti apulumutse ku akaunti.
s.p.profil.vis_contacts: Olankhula anga (zilankhulo zoyambirira, zilankhulo zomwe zimalankhulana ndi dzina lowonekera kokha)
s.p.profil.vis_need_sync: Kuti anthu anu adziwe zinenero zanu, muyenera kuyambitsa “Sankhani kuakaunti yanga”.
s.p.profil.never: Sichiwoneka: imelo yanu, zipangizo zanu, zosankha zanu, momwe mumaphunzira.
s.p.profil.consent: Ndikuvomereza kuti masamba anga a zazinenero azisungidwa pa seva ya projekiti (Supabase, European Union) kuti ndizitha kuzipezanso m'makompyuta anga ena. Ndingathe kuchotsa izi nthawi iliyonse poletsa sync: kopira la seva lidzathetsedwa.
s.p.profil.consent_need: Sankhani bokosi la kuvomereza kuti mubwezeretse paakaunti yanu, kapena kutsegula sync.
s.p.profil.avatar_note: Avatar: ziyambi zanu. Palibe chithunzi chomwe chimatumizidwa kapena kusungira.
s.p.profil.saved_sync: Kusunga pa chipangizochi ndi ku akaunti yanu.
s.p.profil.sync_err: Kusungidwa pa chipangizochi. Akaunti yanu siyitha kusinthidwa ({m}). Phunziraninso pambuyo pake.
s.p.profil.offline: Offline: anapulumutsidwa pa chipangizo ichi kokha. Tap "Sankhani"nso pamene kugwirizana.
s.p.profil.erase: Chotsani ma profile anga a zinenero
s.p.profil.erased_sync: Profile ya chilankhulo idzathetsedwa kuchokera pa chipangizochi ndi ku akaunti yanu.
